stories.title: Genome modelling and design across all domains of life with Evo 2
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 04 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10176-5Evo 2 is an artificial intelligence-based biological foundation model trained on 9 trillion DNA base pairs spanning all domains of life that predicts functional properties from genomic sequences and provides a rich generative model for researchers in biology.

stories.title: A metabolic alarmin from keratinocytes potentiates systemic humoral immunity
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 04 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10167-6Farnesyl pyrophosphate—a mevalonate pathway metabolic intermediate—is an endogenous alarmin that enhances IgG antibody responses through keratinocyte-derived IL-6 and CCL20.

stories.title: Paza: Introducing automatic speech recognition benchmarks and models for low resource languages
stories.summary: Microsoft Research unveils Paza, a human-centered speech pipeline, and PazaBench, the first leaderboard for low-resource languages. It covers 39 African languages and 52 models and is tested with communities in real settings.
